paper_record.title: Thermodynamic-Kinetic Decoupling Enables Stable Excitonic Emission in Defect-Tolerant Cu-Based Quantum Dots
paper_record.abstract: Colloidal quantum dots that simultaneously offer room-temperature single-photon purity and high photoluminescence quantum yield are sought for quantum optics, but remain elusive in environmentally benign materials. We introduce a thermodynamic-kinetic decoupling strategy that transforms defect-tolerant CuInS2 quantum dots into bright, narrowband, and photostable single-photon emitters. Zn2+ alloying strains the lattice, thermodynamically suppressing native copper vacancies and narrowing the emission from a broad defect band of approximately 300 meV to an excitonic line of approximately 120 meV. Ga3+ incorporation then kinetically pins the cation sublattice against Cu+ migration, preventing defect regeneration during ZnS shell growth. The resulting Cd-free core/shell dots achieve near-unity quantum yield of approximately 98% while retaining narrow excitonic emission. Critically, room-temperature single-dot spectroscopy reveals homogeneous linewidths as low as approximately 58 meV, strongly suppressed blinking, and high-purity single-photon emission with g2(0) = 0.06. This stabilized excitonic emission directly reduces reabsorption losses in luminescent solar concentrators, yielding an external optical efficiency of 12.68%. Our work establishes a generalizable framework to unlock intrinsic excitonic photophysics in ion-mobile, defect-prone semiconductors, opening a viable path toward high-performance heavy-metal-free emitters for quantum light sources.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过热力学-动力学解耦策略，实现了无镉铜基量子点的窄带激子发射和高稳定性。
one_sentence_summary.en: Achieved stable narrowband excitonic emission in Cd-free Cu-based quantum dots via a thermodynamic–kinetic decoupling strategy.

problem.zh: 铜基三元量子点（如CuInS2）因缺陷形成能低和离子迁移率高，通常表现为宽带缺陷发射，且在壳层生长等加工过程中光谱极易劣化。
problem.en: Cu-based multinary quantum dots typically exhibit broad defect-mediated emission and spectral degradation during processing due to low defect formation energy and high ion mobility.

approach.zh: 提出“应变与锚定”策略：利用Zn合金化产生的晶格应变热力学抑制缺陷形成，并引入Ga离子动力学锁定阳离子亚晶格，防止加工过程中的缺陷再生。
approach.en: Proposed a "strain-and-pin" strategy: using Zn alloying to induce lattice strain for thermodynamic suppression of defects, and Ga incorporation to kinetically pin the cation sublattice against defect regeneration.

main_takeaway.zh: 将CuInS2的发射从宽缺陷带（~300 meV）缩窄至激子线（~120 meV），实现了98%的荧光产率、室温单光子发射（g2(0)=0.06）及高效太阳能聚光器应用。
main_takeaway.en: Narrowed CuInS2 emission from a broad defect band (~300 meV) to an excitonic line (~120 meV), achieving 98% PLQY, room-temperature single-photon emission (g2(0)=0.06), and efficient luminescent solar concentrators.

why_it_matters.zh: 该工作打破了无重金属量子点在效率、色纯度与稳定性之间的权衡限制，为开发环保型量子光源和光电器件提供了新路径。
why_it_matters.en: This work breaks the efficiency–purity–stability trade-off in heavy-metal-free quantum dots, opening a viable path for eco-friendly quantum light sources and optoelectronic devices.

reason.zh: 通过创新的热力学与动力学协同调控，解决了铜基量子点长期存在的缺陷发射难题，并展示了优异的单颗粒光学性能。
reason.en: Resolved the long-standing defect emission issue in Cu-based QDs through innovative synergistic thermodynamic and kinetic control, demonstrating superior single-particle optical performance.

reason.zh: 论文涵盖了基础物理机制创新、单颗粒光谱表征以及高性能器件应用，符合该期刊对纳米材料深度与广度的要求。
reason.en: The paper covers fundamental physical mechanism innovation, single-dot spectroscopy, and high-performance device applications, meeting the journal's requirements for depth and breadth in nanomaterials.
